verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const die=m=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const r=f=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const mig=fs.readdirSync("supabase/migrations").filter(f=>f.endsWith(".sql")).map(f=>r("supabase/migrations/"+f)).join("\n");if(!/create table if not exists public\.post_embeddings[\s\S]{0,200}vector\(384\)/.test(mig))die("no post_embeddings table: posts are never embedded");if(!/create or replace function public\.post_interest_scores/.test(mig))die("nothing scores a post against what the viewer engages with");const cron=r("app/api/cron/embed-posts/route.ts");if(!/backfillPostEmbeddings\(/.test(cron))die("no embed-posts cron");const v=JSON.parse(r("vercel.json"));if(!(v.crons||[]).some(c=>c.path==="/api/cron/embed-posts"))die("embed-posts is not scheduled in vercel.json");const br=r("lib/feed/blend-rank.ts");if(/post-content embeddings land later/.test(br))die("blend-rank still says post-content embeddings land later");if(!/interest: number/.test(br)||!/ctx\.interest\?\.get\(item\.id\)/.test(br))die("blend-rank has no interest term");const fl=r("components/feed/feed-list.tsx");if(!/getPostInterest\(/.test(fl)||!/interest, radiusM/.test(fl))die("the For you feed does not pass the interest map to the blend");const t=r("lib/feed/blend-rank.test.ts");if(!/leaves the ranking exactly as it was when no post has an interest score/.test(t))die("nothing measures the new term against the current ranking")'

append.detail: Posts are embedded and ranked on it. Migration 20270346002300 adds post_embeddings (384-d gte-small, service role only, hnsw) and post_interest_scores(viewer, post_ids): cosine similarity to the centroid of the posts the viewer recently reacted to, replied to or wrote, service role only. The embed-posts cron (hourly, budget 100, newest top-level posts first, AI kill switch respected) fills it. blend-rank gains an interest signal (weight 0.25) that is present only when both vectors exist, so it renormalises away otherwise; measured against the current ranking by a test that pins the order and every score unchanged with no interest scores, and lifts or lowers a post when it has one. Both blend callers (feed-list For you, feed-page) pass it.
